steps.name: archaeologist of justice
steps.objective: Go to ‘Treasure Beach’ located on Merrin Island and find ‘Case’.

steps.name: On behalf of heaven (1)
steps.objective: At ‘Treasure Beach’, defeat ‘Angry Naga’, ‘Green Dragon Turtle’ and ‘Fishman Soldier’ and report to Case.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Oh, you are... !

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I heard a lot of rumors!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Adventurer %s who does not shy away from solving even the most difficult tasks with ease!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Although my name is %s... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's not that great of a person.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Anyway, it's important to be a competent Adventurer!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Let me introduce myself.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Case, I'm an archaeologist, and I'm studying the ruins here on Merrin Island.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: However, a mad scientist named Doctor SD suddenly appeared and took over the ruins.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mad scientist? Is SD an abbreviation for your name?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: They said something about Sund, but I don’t even want to know… .

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: He brought an excavation team and a mercenary group and occupied the ruins.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: And they are destroying it by digging it up!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I can't forgive you.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: You're trying to destroy a historical site... !

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I just kick them out?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Yes! From illegal occupation to reckless robbery... .

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Anyone can see that he is a villain!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Not only that, but monsters are coming because of them!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: If we keep this up, this place will become a mess!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. All right. I will step forward.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Please do your best to get the job done!

steps.name: On behalf of heaven (2)
steps.objective: In ‘Treasure Cave’, kill ‘Dirty Excavator’, ‘Cruel Excavator’, ‘Brown Bomb Group Sniper’, and ‘Brown Bomb Group Cannon Shooter’ and report to [Case].

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Rather, there are not enough rumors.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I've seen people who can fly for a long time, but I've never seen someone fight so well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess my skills have improved a bit in the meantime... .

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Lie! If this is just a little bit, what if it increases even more?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, now that we've finished cleaning up the ruins, let's go inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you have anything you want to say, say it now.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: What do you want to say?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Um, ummm, so… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If not, let’s go in like this… .

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Ah! I remembered!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Please be careful not to damage the historical site.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: There are many relics and treasures that have not yet been released to the world. Surely, it will later help inform people about the ancient history of this world.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Did you know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will be as careful as possible.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I will be here, so please come to me if you have any problems!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: We will help you as much as we can!

steps.name: On behalf of heaven (3)
steps.objective: Defeat ‘Doctor SD’ in ‘Treasure Cave’ and report to [Case].

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Doctor SD is known as a mad scientist down there.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: It looks like his family was killed by a foreign tribe... .

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: After that, he began to focus on science and technology for revenge.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was a story.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Is there anyone in the world who doesn’t have a story?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: After that, I walked around the ruins… .

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: They say they are working on gathering mysterious powers that cannot be solved by science and weaponizing them.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: It is said that the strange machines you ride around were made that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I guess I'll just have to solve the problem by scaring them away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I haven't committed any major sins... .

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: What are you talking about?!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: How many historical sites did that person damage?!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: What a big sin that is...

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: You're so careless in saying you're not an archaeologist!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, sorry.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Please make sure to scold him so he doesn't come near me again.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Did you know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Actually, that's my specialty. Hehe… ..

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: My personality is a bit... .

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: You must have been very annoyed dealing with me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad you know... .

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Yes?!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: What did you just say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, it seems like things have been resolved... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now you can focus on your research.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you have any problems, please contact me.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Oh my, are you going to help me again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The idea is to ensure after-sales service.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Hehe, I see.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Anyway, thank you for your hard work!

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: See you next time!
